column2: [intro]
I promised myself I’d quit, but what irony,
In just half an hour, it all went up in smoke, you see.
I counted the cigarettes, hoping it would end,
But I cracked, smoked them all, such a silly trend.
I smoked my last pack in thirty minutes flat,
It was so funny, I lost my balance, imagine that.
The rising smoke, I thought I saw unicorns,
The puff party, yeah, I was stiff as a throne.
My friends looked on, stunned and confused,
They said, “You’ve lost it, you’re really bemused.”
I replied with a grin, my smile a bit tight,
“It’s just a flash party, I had to take flight.”
I smoked my last pack in thirty minutes flat,
It was so funny, I lost my balance, imagine that.
The rising smoke, I thought I saw unicorns,
The puff party, yeah, I was stiff as a throne.
[solo]
And now I promise, leaping through the air,
Never to smoke so much in one go, I swear.
My last pack was my final spree,
The puff party was my last dance, you see.
[outro]
